# JoiPlay Shortcut Generator 1.0.0

The first official release of JoiPlay Shortcut Generator.

## Highlights

- Browse and launch games from your JoiPlay library.
- Generate `.jp` or `.joiplay` shortcut files for compatible frontends.
- Track generated files with live `generated/total` counts and fresh folder checks.
- Customize the library view, sorting, theme, tap behavior, and game artwork.

Install the generator APK and one of the included modified JoiPlay APKs matching your JoiPlay version. Back up JoiPlay before replacing an existing installation.
